description: Data Set for Dynamic Expansion Planning of a Commercial Virtual Power Plant through Coalition with Distributed Energy Resources considering Rival Competitors is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors SANTIAGO MAIZ. This database contains data used to develop the problem in the paper named "Dynamic Expansion Planning of a Commercial Virtual Power Plant through Coalition with Distributed Energy Resources considering Rival Competitors". Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
